description: Output classes. Migrated from output_class_templates.json v0.7.0 on methods_02 (81a04b1).

entries.name: fit_statistics
entries.label: Fit statistics
entries.description: Family of overall model goodness-of-fit summary tables.

entries.name: fit_statistics_basic
entries.label: Basic fit statistics
entries.description: Basic model fit indices common to most likelihood-based models.

entries.name: fit_statistics_linear
entries.label: Linear-model fit statistics
entries.description: Linear-model fit indices including R-squared.

entries.name: fit_statistics_concordance
entries.label: Concordance-based fit statistics
entries.description: Fit indices including the concordance statistic (logistic regression, Cox PH).

entries.name: type3_tests
entries.label: Type III tests
entries.description: Family of per-term omnibus tests.

entries.name: type3_tests_f
entries.label: Type III F-tests
entries.description: Type III F-tests with sums-of-squares decomposition (linear models).

entries.name: type3_tests_mixed
entries.label: Type III F-tests (mixed/multivariate)
entries.description: Type III F-tests for mixed and multivariate models (no SS/MS exposure).

entries.name: type3_tests_chi_squared
entries.label: Type III chi-squared tests
entries.description: Type III Wald or LR chi-squared tests (logistic regression, Cox PH).

entries.name: test_result
entries.label: Test result
entries.description: Family of single-row test result tables.

entries.name: chi_squared_test_result
entries.label: Chi-squared test result
entries.description: Single chi-squared test result.

entries.name: t_test_result
entries.label: T-test result
entries.description: Single t-test result (one-sample, paired, or two-sample).

entries.name: exact_test_result
entries.label: Exact test result
entries.description: Exact test result (Fisher exact) — p-value only.

entries.name: homogeneity_test
entries.label: Homogeneity test
entries.description: Breslow-Day test for homogeneity of odds ratios across strata.

entries.name: parameter_estimates
entries.label: Parameter estimates
entries.description: Family of per-coefficient model parameter tables.

entries.name: parameter_estimates_linear
entries.label: Linear-model parameter estimates
entries.description: Linear-model coefficients with t-based inference.

entries.name: parameter_estimates_glm
entries.label: GLM parameter estimates
entries.description: GLM coefficients with z-based inference; includes odds_ratio for logistic.

entries.name: parameter_estimates_cox
entries.label: Cox PH parameter estimates
entries.description: Cox PH coefficients with z-based inference; includes hazard_ratio.

entries.name: covariance_parameters
entries.label: Covariance parameters
entries.description: Estimated covariance/variance components of the random-effects structure.

entries.name: contrasts
entries.label: Contrasts
entries.description: Family of contrast tables — linear combinations of model coefficients with inference.

entries.name: contrasts_t
entries.label: T-based contrasts
entries.description: Contrasts from linear models with t-based inference.

entries.name: contrasts_z
entries.label: Z-based contrasts
entries.description: Contrasts from GLM or Cox PH with z-based inference.

entries.name: association_measures
entries.label: Association measures
entries.description: Family of effect-size / association measure tables with inference.

entries.name: odds_ratio_measures
entries.label: Odds ratio measures
entries.description: Odds ratio with confidence interval (CMH common OR or per-stratum, Fisher OR).

entries.name: marginal_estimates
entries.label: Marginal estimates
entries.description: Family of model-derived estimates at specific factor levels — adjusted means and predictions from a fitted model, distinct from raw coefficient estimates.

entries.name: ls_means
entries.label: Least-squares means
entries.description: Least-squares means (adjusted marginal means) per factor level or level combination.

entries.name: point_estimate
entries.label: Point estimate
entries.description: Estimated mean (or paired-difference mean) with inference.

entries.name: exponentiated_estimates
entries.label: Exponentiated estimates
entries.description: Family of coefficients exponentiated from a transformed scale (log, logit) back to the natural scale of multiplicative effects.

entries.name: odds_ratio_estimates
entries.label: Odds ratio estimates
entries.description: Odds ratios with confidence intervals (exponentiated logistic coefficients).

entries.name: hazard_ratio_estimates
entries.label: Hazard ratio estimates
entries.description: Hazard ratios with confidence intervals (exponentiated Cox coefficients).

entries.name: omnibus_tests
entries.label: Omnibus tests
entries.description: Family of overall-model significance tests indexed by test type (Wilks, Pillai, likelihood ratio, Wald, score, etc.), distinct from per-term tests.

entries.name: multivariate_tests
entries.label: Multivariate tests
entries.description: Multivariate test statistics for overall hypothesis (Wilks, Pillai, Hotelling-Lawley, Roy).

entries.name: global_tests
entries.label: Global tests
entries.description: Overall model significance tests (likelihood ratio, Wald, score).

entries.name: survival_outputs
entries.label: Survival outputs
entries.description: Family of outputs from time-to-event analyses — life tables, median survival, event counts, landmark estimates.

entries.name: survival_table
entries.label: Survival table
entries.description: Life table with survival estimates at each event time.

entries.name: median_survival
entries.label: Median survival
entries.description: Median survival time per group.

entries.name: event_summary
entries.label: Event summary
entries.description: Summary counts of events and censoring per group.

entries.name: landmark_estimates
entries.label: Landmark estimates
entries.description: Survival probability at specific landmark times.

entries.name: group_summaries
entries.label: Group summaries
entries.description: Family of descriptive summaries broken down by group — proportions, frequency tables, quartile estimates. No model fit involved.

entries.name: proportion_estimate
entries.label: Proportion estimate
entries.description: Group-wise proportion with optional confidence interval.

entries.name: frequency_table
entries.label: Frequency table
entries.description: Counts of response categories per group.

entries.name: cumulative_frequency_table
entries.label: Cumulative frequency table
entries.description: Cumulative counts and percentages of response categories per group.

entries.name: quartile_estimates
entries.label: Quartile estimates
entries.description: Q1 and Q3 quartile estimates per group.

entries.name: computed_value
entries.label: Computed value
entries.description: Family of single-value atomic outputs (one value per row) produced by descriptive statistics and derivations. The FHIR datatype is supplied by the bound concept at transformation time via concept.result.valueType — the template carries the shape only, not the type.
